finding.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
finding.summary: an admin-uploaded email template is written with Path.Combine(viewsRootPath, file.FileName) with no rejection of traversal sequences in the client-supplied FileName, so on an app using AddRazorRuntimeCompilation() a crafted FileName like "../../Views/Shared/_Injected.cshtml" places an executable .cshtml inside the Views tree outside the nominal EmailTemplates subfolder
